Hi Rachel —

Thanks for the time earlier. As part of Acme Research's SOC 2 / SIG intake we're documenting access lifecycle controls for third-party platforms. Can you send the following artifacts (redacted where necessary) so our engineering and audit teams can validate? We're hoping to complete this review by next Friday.

Ask list (high priority):
- Account lifecycle map: provisioning -> role assignment -> periodic attestation -> deprovisioning (prefer XLSX)
- SCIM delta sample for a recent bulk deprovisioning (CSV or log snippet)
- Representative SAML assertion samples for a login and a service-to-service token exchange (date-stamped)
- Service account inventory and justification for any non-human credentials (owner + TTL policy)
- Role ownership matrix showing role names, permissions summary, and owner
- Description of termination workflow and how access is revoked across systems (including any automated steps)
- Evidence of most recent access review and cadence (calendar or PDF)

If there are any items that require an NDA or secure upload, let me know and we can provide a one-time secure link. We prefer artifacts be uploaded to our secure collection portal (see link in footer) or delivered via DocuSign for legal-only items.

Thanks — appreciate a short reply confirming timeline and who on your side will own the deliverables.

Best,
Samira Khan
Information Security Manager
Acme Research
